title: Anatomy of a Fall
description: A woman is suspected of her husband's murder, and their blind son faces a moral dilemma as the sole witness.

title: Thank God: Christmas at the Keller Ranch
description: An unexpected romance develops between a no-nonsense rancher and an injured hockey player as he undergoes equine-assisted therapy.

title: Bringing Christmas Home
description: A professor of military history teams with an antique store owner to help track down the original owner of a historic World War II uniform and the love letters in its pockets.

title: Mistletoe Time Machine
description: Three ex-best friends are forced back together when a magical incident sends them back to a pivotal moment in their shared past.

title: Hitpig!
description: A clever bounty-hunting pig must return a dancing elephant to a Las Vegas circus to collect $1 million. However, when the mission goes sideways, he soon realizes that no amount of money is worth losing his newfound friends.

title: The Traitors
description: The ultimate game of deception is back as an all-star cast descends on the Scottish Highlands; the Traitors are chosen, but there's a twist; the players start building the prize pot for the Faithful to share or the Traitors to steal.

title: Site Unseen: An Emma Fielding Mystery
description: Archaeologist Emma Fielding unearths evidence of a 17th-century coastal Maine settlement that predates Jamestown, but the dead body that accompanies it embroils Emma and her students in a different kind of investigation.

title: Emma Fielding Mysteries
description: Emma is hired to consult on the acquisition of a castle-like estate that local legends claim carries a curse.

title: Emma Fielding Mysteries
description: While hosting a gathering of the Association for the Study of American Archaeology, Emma Fielding is thrust into the middle of a murder mystery when the president of her organization is poisoned on the eve of announcing her successor.

title: Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle
description: Four high school kids discover an old video game console and are drawn into the game's jungle setting, literally becoming the adult avatars they chose. What they discover is that you don't just play Jumanji - you must survive it. To beat the game and return to the real world, they'll have to go on the most dangerous adventure of their lives, discover what Alan Parrish left 20 years ago, and change the way they think about themselves - or they'll be stuck in the game forever.

title: The Addams Family
description: Members of the mysterious and spooky Addams Family -- Gomez, Morticia, Pugsley, Wednesday, Uncle Fester and Grandma -- are readily preparing for a visit from their even creepier relatives. But trouble soon arises when shady TV personality Margaux Needler realizes that the Addams' eerie hilltop mansion is standing in the way of her dream to sell all the houses in the neighborhood.

title: The Idea of You
description: A 40-year-old single mom begins an unexpected romance with a 24-year-old boy band singer.

title: Sainte Barbe
description: An inventive young boy tries to maintain the connection with his rebellious grandfather even beyond death.

title: Eenie Meanie
description: Edie is a former getaway driver who's trying to turn her life around and go straight. However, when her ex-boyfriend lands in trouble with a local kingpin, she finds herself caught up in a risky plot to rob a casino.

title: Lee Cronin's The Mummy
description: The young daughter of a journalist disappears into the desert without a trace. Eight years later, the broken family is shocked when she's returned to them. However, what should be a joyful reunion soon turns into a living nightmare as she starts to transform into something truly horrifying.

title: Gladiator II
description: Years after witnessing the death of Maximus at the hands of his uncle, Lucius must enter the Colosseum after the powerful emperors of Rome conquer his home. With rage in his heart and the future of the empire at stake, he looks to the past to find the strength and honor needed to return the glory of Rome to its people.

title: Special Delivery
description: Ralph's life starts going downhill when he doesn't clear the snow from the front sidewalk.

title: Garage Sale Mysteries
description: A bass player is found dead before a planned tour with a big country singer.

title: Garage Sale Mysteries
description: Jenn finds the body of a local college history professor hidden in a suit of armor she purchased; as more murders occur, she finds herself caught in the killer's web.

title: Garage Sale Mystery: A Case of Murder
description: After buying an old reel-to-reel recorder at a garage sale, Jenn discovers that it includes the sound of a man pleading for his life.

title: A Christmas Star
description: An astronomer predicts that a new meteor shower will appear over a tiny town, but she must convince the locals to help with her discovery at the expense of a Christmas tradition.

title: The Day the Earth Blew Up: A Looney Tunes Movie
description: Porky Pig and Daffy Duck become Earth's only hope when their antics at the local bubble-gum factory uncover a secret alien mind-control plot. Faced with cosmic odds, they must save their town and the world while not driving each other totally loony.

title: The Land Before Time
description: Littlefoot, a young plant-eating dinosaur, is orphaned after his mother perishes while protecting him from a vicious carnivore. With her last breath, she tells him how to get to the legendary Great Valley, where he will be reunited with others of his kind. With his friend Cera, Littlefoot sets out for the fabled land, meeting a variety of new friends along the way -- while also being tracked by the killer dinosaur that mortally wounded his mother.

title: Charlie the Wonderdog
description: A dog gains superpowers after his owner is abducted by aliens. Together they battle an evil cat threatening humanity while the dog becomes a famous superhero.

title: The Christmas Clues
description: Piper, a big-city writer, thinks she left her hometown and first love, Dawson, behind. But when they're both invited home for the holidays to compete for their late mentor's estate, they unravel clues and challenges with other former students.

title: The Holiday Proposal Plan
description: Sparks fly when travel columnist Sonny Kravitz and her ex-boyfriend team up to help their best friends get engaged during Christmastime.

title: The Addams Family 2
description: Hoping to get closer as a family, Gomez, Morticia and the rest of the Addams clan embark on an adventurous road trip in a hideous and humongous camper.
